questions.stem: In a Venn diagram, what does the region where two circles overlap represent?

options.text: The union of the two sets
The intersection of the two sets
The difference of the two sets
The complement of the two sets

questions.explanation: The overlapping region in a Venn diagram represents the intersection of the two sets, which includes all elements that are common to both sets.

distractorRationale.c: The difference of sets is not represented by the overlap.
distractorRationale.d: The complement refers to elements not in the set, not the overlap.
